about: What is new in the next release, as the Studio shows it after an update and in its update banner. tools/release/make_release_json.py copies this into release.json. Keep it to a handful of lines a user can act on; page is a Studio page (the palette's module name, e.g. semicrystalline, or a command id such as module.open thermal). The full changelog stays in tools/docs/src/whatsnew.md.
title: October 2026 update

highlights.title: Semicrystalline stacks
highlights.detail: Build lamellar cells: a crystal lamella from the polymer crystal library and an amorphous layer of loops, bridges and tails in the fractions you ask for, with crystallinity, density and P2 profiles reported.

highlights.title: Thermal conductivity by MD
highlights.detail: Green-Kubo from the heat-flux autocorrelation, or reverse NEMD. You say whether the material is a 3D bulk or a 2D sheet; LAMMPS inputs cover the long runs on a cluster.

highlights.title: Polymer crystals for DFT
highlights.detail: Unit cells of PE, iPP, PEO, PVDF, POM, the nylons, PET, PLLA, natural rubber and PTFE from their structure papers, a four-step VASP relaxation chain, and phono3py sets with a cost estimate before anything is submitted.

highlights.title: Figures ready for a journal
highlights.detail: Every plot saves as a one- or two-column figure (vector PDF or SVG, or 300 dpi PNG) in one consistent look, and copies its data as CSV.

highlights.title: Force fields from their original sources
highlights.detail: Every library file is built from its paper, supporting information or the authors' own distribution, and says where its numbers came from. Waters, gases, Martini 2, SDK and L-OPLS are new.

highlights.title: Missing parameters filled by CAPS ML
highlights.detail: When a force field lacks a torsion, bend or bond, CAPS can fit it to relaxed scans with its own model and marks every such term in the files it writes.

highlights.title: Update notices
highlights.detail: CAPS Studio now tells you when a newer CAPS is out and shows what changed after you update. Settings has the switch.
